name: grid-subgrid-edge-hypothetical-empty-tracks
derivation: Only the middle track is occupied. The 31px leaf creates a 50px hypothetical item spanning tracks 1-2 (31+19 start margin), and a 54px item spanning tracks 2-3 (31+23 end margin). With fixed empty edge tracks 5 and 7, the middle auto track must be max(31,50-5,54-7)=47px; the parent is 59px wide. The subgrid border box begins at x=19 and is 59-19-23=17px wide. Internal grid lines still align to the parent: the leaf starts at root x=5, hence local x=-14, intentionally overflowing the subgrid start edge rather than shifting the inherited line.
